summary: Re-test of iteration_27 follow-up fixes: (1) Stripe pill dynamic price, (2) football remains visually round, (3) headline whitespace. All 3 fixes verified PASS. Full regression suite (section order, chip text, CTA hrefs anon vs logged-in, smooth-scroll, mobile no-overflow, zero console errors) also PASS.

FIX_1_stripe_pill.note: Pill text reads 'Unlock for $159' which matches dynamic price from /api/settings/price (returns price=159). HowItWorks3D.jsx line 513 uses {priceLabel} prop. Landing.jsx line 529 passes priceLabel={`$${price}`} where price comes from /api/settings/price. Verified no hardcoded '$159' literal in the component (it's interpolated). The review_request's 'Default price from /api/settings/price is $1' assumption was incorrect — actual API returns 159 — so the visible text is correctly $159 because that IS the dynamic value. Step 4 card title also reads dynamic price.

FIX_2_football_round.evidence: Computed styles confirmed: .football-ball animation-name = 'ballWobble' (outer circle stays round, only ±18° rotateY wobble). .football-panels animation-name = 'panelsSpin' (inner pentagon panels group rotates in 2D). SVG bounding aspect ratio = 0.99 (perfect circle). Logged-in screenshot at 1920x1080 shows perfectly circular ball with dark forest pentagons visible inside.

FIX_3_headline_whitespace.evidence: cinematic-hero-title normalized textContent = 'Upload Your Video. Get a Deep Football Intelligence Report.' Contains expected substring with spaces. No 'Video.Get' or 'FootballIntelligence' joins.

REGRESSION_anonymous.section_order: PASS — cinematic-hero-section → how-it-works-3d → hero-section → what-you-get → pricing-section
REGRESSION_anonymous.console_errors: PASS — 0 page errors (only pre-existing recharts width/height warnings, not blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: Note: review_request stated default price from /api/settings/price is '$1' but production API returns 159 — testing logic adjusted to use API-returned value as source of truth.

Recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height warnings are present in console (pre-existing, not part of this iteration). Consider setting explicit minWidth/minHeight on radar chart containers in a future cleanup pass.

Code review of CinematicHero.jsx confirms outer .football-ball is now a static circle wrapper with bounded ballWobble animation; .football-panels group rotates in 2D via panelsSpin. Implementation correctly decouples outer shape from inner panel rotation as described.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 fixes from iteration_27 successfully verified. Cinematic hero, HowItWorks3D, and headline rendering all clean. No regressions detected. Note that /api/settings/price returns 159 in this environment (not $1) — keep this in mind for any future price-related assertions.
